_comment: Distributions that ship GPL or LGPL code in binary form (a `License: ...GPL...` line in one of their licence files, or a GPL licence in their metadata). stage-agent.mjs fails when such a distribution is missing here or its version differs, so a Hermes sync that changes one is reviewed. For each listed one, THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES gets the full texts named in `texts` (apps/agent/packaging/licenses/gnu/) and where to get the exact source of each library.

pillow-heif.why: HEIC/HEIF image support, pulled in by hermes-agent and browser-harness (base dependencies, not an extra). Its binary wheels are GPLv2 as a whole because of x265.

libraries.name: x265 4.3
libraries.files: libx265 (pillow_heif.libs/, pillow_heif/.dylibs/ or beside it on Windows)

libraries.name: pillow-heif 1.8.1 build scripts
libraries.files: how the libraries above were configured and built (libheif/build_libs.py, libheif/windows/)

libraries.name: MinGW-w64 runtime (Windows only)
libraries.license: GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1 (libgcc, libstdc++); MIT and BSD (libwinpthread)
